class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/DepthCameraSensor
class.description: Declares a mujoco_rgbd_camera::MujocoDepthCamera through a <mujoco_ros2_plugin> element, mounted on a MuJoCo camera element or on one or two sites, instead of being found by a site prefix.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/LidarSensor
class.description: Declares a mujoco_gl_lidar::MujocoGLLidar through a <mujoco_ros2_plugin> element, mounted on a named site, instead of being found by a site prefix.

class.name: mujoco_ros2_control/BodyServices
class.description: Serves mujoco_get_body_state and mujoco_set_body_pose: reads a body's world pose and twist, and teleports a body with a single free joint. Previously built into the simulation node; declaring this plugin is now what advertises them.
